notes.title: TouchPad Movement and Breakable Objects
notes.content:
This update is the first step toward our Ogre milestone.
 See our  Fadeholm Road Map for future developments!

6/1/2018 Baseline Update 1.1:

 Added TouchPad movement: Touch to walk, Press to run.  Controller configurable through the Options Menu.  Can be configured to work in coordination with Arm Swing locomotion to enable sprinting.
 Added option to halt player motion when jumping to make it easier to designate the desired jump location. Configurable in the Options Menu under Locomotion.
 Added breakable vases, barrels, and crates. Objects can be moved, rolled, thrown, slammed. 
 Added haptic feedback to all dials, levers, sliders, and lids.
 Added four Tutorial panels to the Options menu to help explain game mechanics: Controls, Inventory, Combat, and Floating Text. Each of these panels provides basic explanation of user interface and game mechanics.
 Added steps to Tutorial to explain how to use the Satchel to expand player's inventory.
 AutoSave enabled: For deeper dungeons (accessed through Explore mode), progress will be saved every 3 levels starting with the 4th.  Even upon death, the Fade can return to the ‘autosaved’ location.


Fixed HMD improper fading during scene transitions. 
Fixed issue with weapons sometimes needing to be ‘re-grabbed’ in order to do damage after returning from the System(Steam) menu.
Fixed HMD 'tilting'(batman effect) when restoring save games. Restored save games will now always be 'on the level'. 
Fixed issue with excessive inventory haptic feedback. 


Potions are now more fragile. Be careful, dropping them may cause them to break!
Removed ability to wrist spam in combat to damage mobs. Valid combat swings must pass both a velocity and 'travel distance' check before they deal damage.
Expanded distance player hands may be from each other to activate Item inspection. This should make inspecting items a little easier. (Don't forget to press UP on the touchpad too!) 
Book Adjustments: Can now trigger pull to get pages to turn. This option is in addition to using the other hand to turn pages by touching them or swiping left/right. [Note:Unmovable books do not respond to trigger inputs] 
Physics enabled on creatures: They will now do a better job of observing the random debri and decor found throughout the dungeon.  Additionally, attempting to run through creatures blocking your path will cost the player endurance.


Please continue to provide us feedback via our Facebook, Twitter, and Steam Forums. Or email us at Fadeholm@infiniteopal.com .

Notes:
[olist]
 For the best play experience it is recommended that you ‘Reset’ your game settings from the Options Menu. 
Due to the number of dynamic objects added during this update, previous saved games may become invalid.
[/olist]
